dish.title: Ginger Scallion Fish Packets
dish.name: Ginger Scallion Fish Packets
dish.description: White fish and bok choy steamed in foil with ginger, scallion, and soy, with rice salted in the pot, served with the packet juices.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: Ginger Scallion Fish Packets
recipe_version.description: White fish and bok choy steamed in foil with ginger, scallion, and soy, with rice salted in the pot, served with the packet juices.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.heat: Oven 400 F, and a saucepan for the rice.
recipe_version.doneness: Fish flakes and is opaque in the center at 145 F. Bok choy is tender. FDA seafood temperature is 145 F.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: For the rice. It is absorbed.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: Regular soy sauce. Wheat and soy.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: All of it goes in the rice water. The fish is seasoned by the soy sauce. 4 g in 3 cups is about 0.5% because the water is absorbed, not a 1% pasta pot. 4 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (1.5 tsp). The same weight is 0.75 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 0.75 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Rinse the long-grain white rice. Combine it with the water and the Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 18 minutes, until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed. The 4 g is about 0.5% of the 3 cups because that water stays in the rice.

steps.title: Pack the packets
steps.body: Heat the oven to 400 F. On each of 4 foil sheets put 1 white fish fillet and half a head of bok choy. Divide the ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and the water for packets across the four packets. Seal the foil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 400 F for 18 to 20 minutes, until the fish flakes, is opaque in the center, and reads 145 F, and the bok choy is tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Open the foil carefully. Spoon the packet juices over the fish and the rice. Those juices are the sauce.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Dairy-free only. No milk, butter, cheese, or cream. Not plant and not vegetarian, because of the fish. Not gluten-free, because the soy sauce is wheat. fish and finfish are not dietary labels.
allergen_notes: Finfish from the white fish. Soy and wheat from regular soy sauce.
Rice, ginger, scallion, bok choy, and water add none of egg, milk, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, or shellfish.
Do not swap in tamari or gluten-free soy sauce. That would be a different recipe.

dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Finfish. Not an HH001 plant meal.
